description: Extends the org preset, which carries the release-age floor, the automerge stance, the CVE opt-out and the shared grouping rules. Only what is specific to this repository stays here.
Rules here are appended AFTER the preset's and later rules win, so nothing below may set automerge or minimumReleaseAge without meaning to override the org posture for every package it matches.

customManagers.description: The Go version both workflows install. Native managers do not read setup-go's input, so without this the CI toolchain silently diverges from go.mod. Scoped to any workflow rather than one filename: a manager pinned to a single file stops watching the moment the step it covers moves, which is silent.
